messages:
Jessica - CS: FYI incoming escalation from AcmeCorp — their search app started returning empty hits after last night's auto model swap. Customer says indexer immediately started failing with 'vector shape mismatch' errors. 😬
Anka (Eng-ML): can you paste the exact error log they sent? sounds like an embedding-dim change during rollout.
Jessica - CS: pasted below from their engineer (redacted customer id):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "open-embedding-xlarge",
  "input": ["foo"]
}
==> 200 OK
{
  "data": [{ "embedding": [0.012, 0.034, ..., 0.998] }],
  "meta": { "dim": 1536 }
}

Indexer log:
[2026-03-15T02:11:02Z] ERROR indexer: vector shape mismatch: expected shape=(1024,), got shape=(1536,)
```
Sam K: customer id? we need to link to their org and cached schema.
Jessica - CS: AcmeCorp-org-451 (support ticket #12345). They said they didn't change anything client-side.
Anka (Eng-ML): yep that's a classic model swap fallout — we rolled a model variant to improve recall last night, that variant produces 1536-d embeddings. The index was created against 1024 dims. Two issues here: immediate ingestion failures + some clients auto-retried the request leading to duplicate/batched jobs and a spike in billed embedding units.
Tim L: looking at deployment history — the swap happened at 2026-03-15T00:47:32Z on hosted inference. Canary completed and rollout hit 100% at 00:50. Routing policy allowed phasing but indexer pool was still pointing at old model in config; mismatch comes when customer migrated model on their side (explicit model param) but indexer mapping stayed.
Maria (SRE): infra also shows a surge in 429s from the indexer during the retry storm:
```
2026-03-15T02:11:05Z WARN http: 429 Too Many Requests - indexer/worker-12
2026-03-15T02:11:06Z WARN retry: backing off 1.2s
```
SupportBot: Alert: backfill-job-ACME-451 failed (100% errors) — created incident INC-8871.
Frank G: immediate mitigation: set routing fallback to previous-embedding-1024 variant for AcmeCorp and pause any automated backfills. That buys time for a coordinated migration plan.
BenP: Agreed. Also need a safe backfill procedure — converting 1536->1024 isn't lossless. Options: (a) re-embed using the old model, (b) project via PCA/sketching (best-effort), (c) reindex as new schema and update vector DB mapping. Which does Acme prefer?
Jessica - CS: asked customer; they want minimal downtime and are okay with re-embedding if we can schedule. Pricing/Billing team flagged they saw a doubling of embedding charges due to retries. Sam, can you confirm billing noise and offer credit?
Sam K: on it. Preliminary: we charged for ~2x embedding calls between 02:11-02:20 due to retries. I'll open a billing review and propose a credit for the excess.
Anka (Eng-ML): for triage + repro, steps I used in a local sandbox to reproduce:
1) Create index with 1024-d embeddings mapping.
2) Insert a vector from model-old (1024) -> success.
3) Swap endpoint to model-new (1536) via rollout.
4) Send an embedding request with model=new -> indexer receives vector shape 1536 -> rejects.
Repro payload:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
 -d '{"model":"open-embed-new-1536","input":["test"]}'
```
Observed: indexer returns 400 shape mismatch and client libs auto-retry -> duplicates.
BenP: For backfill strategy I suggest a staged job: export failed doc ids -> run re-embed with old model variant at controlled QPS -> ingest into a new index or alter mapping with reindex api. We should avoid inline runtime conversions.
Maria (SRE): also recommend increasing indexer queue size and applying stricter client-side idempotency to avoid double-ingest on retries. We saw a bunch of jobs processed twice.
Tim L: quick config to revert routing for AcmeCorp:
```
PATCH /v1/routing/policies/AcmeCorp-org-451 
{ "preferred_model": "open-embed-old-1024", "allow_fallback": true }
```
Anka (Eng-ML): I can publish a model-variant tag to make old model reachable even if rollout continues. Command: 
```
redwood model-tag set open-embed-old-1024 --variant stable --region us-west1
```
Frank G: after rollback, we should run a small smoke backfill (1k docs) to validate success before full restore. Ben, can infra run a throttled backfill job?
BenP: yep. I'll spin a Kubernetes job with concurrency=4 and checkpointing every 500 docs. Backfill plan:
- Start 02:00 UTC
- Batch size 32, concurrency 4, sleep 200ms between batches
- Verify vector dims and checksum on write
- If >2% error rate, pause and escalate.
Jessica - CS: customer okayed scheduling for 03:00 UTC, but asked we minimize cost. I told them re-embed on our hosted for them will be billed normally but we can offer partial credit for the duplicate-charge window.
Sam K: billing note: I'll flag INC-8871 and attach usage logs for 02:10-02:25. Proposed credit = usage_excess * 0.7 (pending finance).
Anka (Eng-ML): long-term fix: we should fail-fast on embed dim mismatch at the API gateway with clear error code and prevent auto-retry in client libs. Also add a model-dim header for compatibility checks: 
```
X-Embedding-Dim: 1536
```
so indexers can reject at gateway and avoid wasted work.
Maria (SRE): filed SRE board item to add a dim-check hook and circuit-breaker.
SupportBot: INC-8871 updated: remediation plan posted, assigned to BenP/Anka/Sam K.
BenP: I'll kick off the throttled backfill at 03:00 UTC and post progress.
Jessica - CS: thanks team. I'll keep AcmeCorp updated and confirm when backfill completes.
Frank G: post-mortem action items: add model-dim validation in rollout playbook, warn customers on model-variant swaps that change dims, add billing soft-stop for retry storms. :memo:
Anka (Eng-ML): noted. I'll draft a short RFC for the model-variant compatibility doc.
Jessica - CS: will follow up with the customer and close the ticket after backfill verification.
BenP: progress update (03:45 UTC): first 5k docs re-embedded, no errors. Continuing.
Jessica - CS: Closing loop: Acme reports search restored at 04:10 UTC. They accepted credit proposal. Thanks everyone. :tada:
